comments.author: Long Ma
comments.text:
Hey Product Hunters! 👋 I'm Long, CEO of Spira AI. Third time launching here in the past few months, feeling good to be back again :)

After our last two launches here I kept hitting the same wall: AI can generate a clip in seconds, but turning it into something you'd post still means opening an editor. Pick a presenter, cut in B-roll, fix the captions, find music. Generation got cheap. Finishing didn't, and finishing is where everyone quietly gives up and posts slop.

That's why we trained **Spira Maxima: a social video model that turns plain text into a finished, viral UGC styled video with nothing left to edit and ready to post right away.**

Here's how it works:

*   Paste your script, and it casts a presenter that fits the topic

*   It cuts on-trend B-roll and motion around your words, then adds captions and music

*   Want it to be you? One photo and a voice sample make your AI clone, same face and voice in every video

*   Selling something? Drop in product shots. Already filmed on your phone? Upload it and it builds the edit around you

*   It's post trained on social trending and performance data, so the look follows what's working on the feed this week

50% off for launch month, we hope you enjoy it.

We'd love your feedback: if a model handed you a finished video every time, would you still want to touch it before posting, or would you let it ship? Paste the script you were going to post anyway and tell me where it nails it and where it embarrasses us.

Looking forward to hearing what you think!! 👇👇👇
comments.kr:

지난 두 번의 런칭 이후 저희는 동일한 한계에 계속 부딪혔습니다. AI가 단 몇 초 만에 클립을 생성할 수는 있지만, 실제로 업로드할 수 있는 결과물을 만들려면 결국 영상 편집기를 켜야 했습니다. 발표자를 선정하고, B-roll 컷을 넣고, 자막을 다듬고, 음악을 찾아야 하죠. 생성 자체는 저렴해졌지만, 완성본을 만드는 작업은 그렇지 않았고, 바로 그 마무리 단계에서 많은 분이 포기하고 조악한 결과물을 올리게 됩니다.

그렇기 때문에 저희는 추가 편집이 전혀 필요 없이 즉시 게시할 수 있는 완성된 바이럴 UGC 스타일 영상을 일반 텍스트로부터 만들어내는 소셜 비디오 모델인 **Spira Maxima**를 훈련시켰습니다.

작동 방식은 다음과 같습니다:

*   스크립트를 붙여넣으면 주제에 어울리는 발표자를 캐스팅합니다.

*   단어에 맞춰 트렌디한 B-roll과 모션을 컷 편집하고 캡션 자막과 음악을 추가합니다.

*   직접 출연하고 싶으신가요? 사진 1장과 음성 샘플로 모든 영상에서 동일한 얼굴과 목소리를 가진 AI 클론을 만듭니다.

*   제품을 판매하시나요? 제품 사진을 넣으시면 됩니다. 이미 휴대폰으로 촬영해 둔 영상이 있으신가요? 업로드하면 여러분을 중심으로 편집을 완성합니다.

*   소셜 트렌드와 성과 데이터를 바탕으로 사후 학습되어, 이번 주 피드에서 반응이 좋은 최신 스타일을 반영합니다.

런칭 첫 달 50% 할인이 적용되니 즐겁게 이용해 주셨으면 좋겠습니다.

여러분의 피드백을 기다립니다. 만약 모델이 매번 완성된 영상을 바로 제공한다면, 게시하기 전에 여전히 손을 대고 싶으신가요, 아니면 바로 게시하시겠습니까? 올리려던 스크립트를 붙여넣어 보시고 잘된 부분과 아쉬운 부분을 알려주세요.

여러분의 의견을 진심으로 기다리겠습니다!! 👇👇👇

comments.author: Ritesh Prasad
comments.text:
Hey Product Hunt! I’m RP, part of the team behind FastRouter.ai.

We built FastRouter because running AI in production meant too much plumbing and too much guesswork: multiple SDKs, scattered dashboards, fragile failover, and no clear answer to “How do we make this cheaper without making it worse?” when all the logs are scattered all over the place.

⚡ One integration. Less provider juggling.

FastRouter gives you a unified API across major models and providers, with support for OpenAI, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini-compatible interfaces.

Claude models, for example, are available through Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI. FastRouter routes requests to healthy upstreams, so you don’t have to maintain separate SDK integrations and failover logic yourself.

Routing is the starting point. Routing Intelligence is what makes FastRouter different.

Most gateways show you traffic and spending. FastRouter helps you figure out what to change:

*   Proactive cost insights: Weekly recommendations based on real traffic. Find cheaper models, prompt caching opportunities, and workloads suited to flex pricing. Model-switching recommendations include evals so you can compare quality before switching.

*   Early warning signs: Spot latency drift, error spikes, and cost anomalies, with alerts delivered to Slack or PagerDuty.

*   Request-level visibility: See which upstream served each request, allocate costs with tags, and inspect logs, including multimodal outputs.

*   Evals beyond text: Evaluate production traffic and datasets, including images and video. A successful API response doesn’t always mean a usable output.

*   Multimodal response caching: Reuse cached image and video responses for matching prompts or cache keys instead of calling the model again.

*   Better prompt management: Keep prompts in a shared, versioned library, with optimization and compression tools to improve them.

Our production customers are already saving $10K+ per month by acting on FastRouter’s recommendations.

Available as SaaS or fully on-prem, with budget caps, alerts, and access controls built in.

We built this to spend less time maintaining integrations and investigating bills, and more time shipping things that work.

Claim 2 months free: https://fastrouter.ai/product-hunt

What’s your biggest AI production headache right now: reliability, cost, integrations, or quality? Let us know in your comments.

comments.author: Ritesh Prasad
comments.text:
@alira_salu We do not use your logs for training if that is a concern. That said, there are two options with regards to your specific query:

*   **Disable content logging per API key:** FastRouter won’t store the prompts or responses passing through the gateway for that key. The trade-off is that those requests won’t be available for AI Evals / Insights / Prompt Optimizations and more, since those features rely on replaying the original requests or importing logs with the original prompt, taking the user feedback on the responses and using the feedback to improve the original prompt.

*   **Deploy in your own environment:** Our enterprise offering supports running FastRouter on-premises / in your own cloud.

comments.author: Alberto Gimeno
comments.text:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

We started Invofox because we kept watching good engineering teams lose entire quarters to document processing. The weekend prototype always works. Then come the scanned faxes, the multi-document PDFs, the tables that span three pages, the tax IDs that only appear in the footer, and suddenly two engineers are maintaining an OCR pipeline instead of building the product.

So we built the pipeline once, properly: intake, dual-pass OCR, splitting, classification, extraction, cross-field validation, confidence scoring, provenance, and a feedback loop that keeps improving on your specific documents. You POST a file to one endpoint and get validated JSON back.

For the last few years that only existed behind an enterprise contract. We were heads-down serving some of the largest tech companies and enterprises in Europe and the US, and honestly, we never built a way for a small team to just try it.

That always felt wrong.

Today that changes. Invofox Self-Serve is the same pipeline and the same accuracy bar, available with a signup form instead of a sales call. Two things we care about most: accuracy is part of our SLAs, and any document where we make a mistake is completely free. Pricing is per page, it goes down with volume, and there are no credit systems to decode.

For Product Hunt: the free tier is 500 pages with no credit card, and we're adding 1,000 extra pages on top for anyone who signs up from here.

Bring us your worst document. The one that broke your last parser. We'd genuinely like to see it, and we'll be in the comments all day.

comments.author: André J
comments.text:
Hi Product Hunt.  
  
For the past two years, we’ve been running AI agents against real production cloud infrastructure at CloudGeni. We learned the hard way that getting an agent to work once is only the beginning. Keeping it running, giving it somewhere safe to execute, connecting users’ accounts, getting human approval, and understanding what happened—and what it cost—is where the work adds up.  
  
We kept rebuilding that infrastructure. So we pulled it out and open-sourced it.

**That’s Opengeni: agents in your product, infrastructure out of the box.**  

It gives developers the pieces they need to ship agents, already wired together:

*   🔄 **Sessions that survive errors**, with a replayable history so you can reconnect and pick up where you left off.
    
*   🖥️ **Sandboxes for agents to do the work**, with credentials handled and memory built in.
    
*   🔌 **Your APIs and your users’ apps, connected.** Bring an OpenAPI or GraphQL spec, or an MCP server, plus 100+ integrations with built-in OAuth.
    
*   ✋ **Human approvals before risky actions**, so people stay in control.
    
*   🔍 **Visibility into every step, token, and dollar**, with built-in dashboards and run traces.
    
*   🧩 **A workspace for each customer** and the freedom to choose your models.
    

Getting it into your product takes three steps: add your API key on the server, mount a handler using your existing authentication, and show the agent in your app—with your own UI or our React components.

You can also try the same sessions in the Opengeni app before embedding them in yours.

**Run it on our cloud or yours.** Opengeni is Apache-2.0 and free to self-host. Our managed cloud is model cost + 5%, with no platform or seat fees. For this launch, the first 100 users get $100 in cloud credit.

We’re in early public preview, and we’d love your feedback: **what’s the first task you’d want an agent to handle inside your product—and what would you need to trust it with that task?**

[Try the cloud](https://app.opengeni.ai/) · [Read the docs](https://docs.opengeni.ai/) · [Self-host on GitHub](https://github.com/Cloudgeni-ai/opengeni)

We’ll be in the comments all day. Thanks for checking us out!

Product Hunt 여러분 안녕하세요.  
  
지난 2년 동안 저희는 CloudGeni에서 실제 프로덕션 클라우드 인프라를 대상으로 AI 에이전트를 운영해 왔습니다. 에이전트를 한 번 작동시키는 것은 시작에 불과하다는 점을 뼈저리게 배웠습니다. 에이전트를 계속 안정적으로 실행하고, 안전한 실행 환경을 제공하고, 사용자의 계정을 연결하고, 사람의 승인을 받고, 무슨 일이 일어났는지와 비용이 얼마나 들었는지를 추적하는 데 엄청난 작업이 누적됩니다.  
  
저희는 그 인프라를 끊임없이 재구축해 왔고, 결국 이를 추출하여 오픈소스로 공개했습니다.

**그것이 바로 Opengeni입니다. 여러분의 제품 속에 에이전트를, 인프라는 상자에서 꺼내 바로 사용하세요.**  

에이전트를 출시하는 데 필요한 모든 구성 요소가 이미 서로 연결된 상태로 개발자에게 제공됩니다:

*   🔄 **오류 발생 시에도 복구되는 세션**: 재생 가능한 히스토리를 통해 다시 연결하고 중단된 지점부터 이어서 작업할 수 있습니다.
    
*   🖥️ **에이전트 작업을 위한 샌드박스**: 자격 증명이 안전하게 처리되며 메모리가 내장되어 있습니다.
    
*   🔌 **자체 API 및 사용자 앱 연결**: OpenAPI 또는 GraphQL 규격, MCP 서버뿐만 아니라 OAuth가 내장된 100개 이상의 연동을 지원합니다.
    
*   ✋ **위험한 작업 전 사람의 승인**: 사람이 항상 제어권을 유지할 수 있습니다.
    
*   🔍 **모든 단계, 토큰, 비용에 대한 가시성**: 내장된 대시보드와 실행 추적 로그를 제공합니다.
    
*   🧩 **고객별 독립 워크스페이스** 및 원하는 모델을 자유롭게 선택할 수 있습니다.
    

제품에 적용하는 과정은 단 세 단계입니다: 서버에 API 키를 추가하고, 기존 인증 체계를 사용하는 핸들러를 마운트한 뒤, 자체 UI나 저희 React 컴포넌트를 사용해 앱에 에이전트를 띄우면 됩니다.

앱에 직접 임베드하기 전에 Opengeni 앱에서 동일한 세션을 먼저 테스트해 보실 수도 있습니다.

**자체 클라우드 또는 저희 클라우드에서 실행하세요.** Opengeni는 Apache-2.0 라이선스로 완전 무료 자체 호스팅이 가능합니다. 매니지드 클라우드는 플랫폼 비용이나 좌석당 요금 없이 모델 원가에 5% 마진만 부과됩니다. 이번 런칭을 기념하여 선착순 100명에게 100달러 상당의 클라우드 크레딧을 제공합니다.

현재 얼리 퍼블릭 프리뷰 단계이며 피드백을 환영합니다. **제품 내에서 에이전트가 가장 먼저 처리해 주었으면 하는 작업은 무엇인가요? 그리고 그 작업을 믿고 맡기기 위해 무엇이 필요하신가요?**

comments.author: Davlet Dzhakishev
comments.text:
@prastik Thanks Prastik, appreciate it!

Good news: long multi-agent runs don't need an open connection at all. You send a message, get a 202 back, and the agent keeps working on a background worker. Close the stream whenever you want, nothing gets cancelled. Sub-agents report back through Postgres, not through your connection.  

If you don't want to stream, use our webhooks (turn.completed, session.requiresAction, etc.) and fetch the events when you need them. If you do stream, it picks up where you left off. And if you meant MCP, our MCP endpoints already use Streamable HTTP.  

On serverless: the core itself doesn't scale to zero today. The workers are long-running and we deploy on Kubernetes or Native Cloud. Your own backend can totally be serverless though, since the SDK runs on edge runtimes. One tip: don't proxy the SSE stream through a function, it'll stay open and cost you. Webhooks are the cheaper way to go.  
  
More here: https://docs.opengeni.ai/integrate/background-agents

No public issue on this yet, feel free to open one! https://github.com/Cloudgeni-ai/opengeni/issues

반가운 소식은 장시간 구동되는 멀티 에이전트 실행에 연결을 계속 열어둘 필요가 전혀 없다는 점입니다. 메시지를 전송하면 202 응답을 받고, 에이전트는 백그라운드 워커에서 작업을 계속 진행합니다. 원하실 때 언제든 스트림을 닫으셔도 작업이 취소되지 않습니다. 서브 에이전트는 연결 세션이 아니라 Postgres를 통해 상태를 보고합니다.

comments.author: Brandon Dennis
comments.text:
Hey everyone!

Brandon here, founder of DailyHelm.  
  
What is DailyHelm  

DailyHelm is an agentic AI business reviewer for online businesses. It turns scattered analytics, ads, SEO, and store data into a prioritized daily action list.

Most founders waste time checking multiple dashboards and still miss revenue leaks. DailyHelm reviews your business overnight and tells you what needs attention today, ranked by revenue impact.

How it Works

Step 1: Tell us about your business - A short setup covering what you sell, who buys it, and what success looks like. This anchors every recommendation.

Step 2: Connect your platforms - Link GA4, Google Ads, Search Console, Shopify, GitHub, GCP billing, and your site; DailyHelm opens the approval page for you to confirm each connection with one click.  
  
Step 3: Get a daily AI business review - Wake up to a prioritized punch list every morning, and chat with agent Aria anytime to dig deeper.  
  
Why It’s Different

It’s not just another analytics dashboard. Every finding includes evidence, confidence, a recommended fix, and an impact score... like broken GA4 tracking, wasted ad spend, SEO regressions, or failed-payment spikes.

Features

*   Daily morning brief with prioritized action items.
    
*   Aria chat for deeper investigation and answers.
    
*   Specialist agents for analytics, ads, SEO, code, cloud cost, and site UX.
    
*   Read-only integrations with GA4, Google Ads, Search Console, Shopify, Stripe, GitHub, Meta Ads, and more.

Who It’s For

*   DTC and Shopify founders.
    
*   Dropshippers, SaaS operators, and solo founders.
    
*   Agencies and anyone wearing multiple hats in a growing business.

Use Cases

*   Spot broken conversion tracking.
    
*   Find wasted or inefficient ad spend.
    
*   Catch SEO and site-performance regressions.
    
*   Monitor failed payments and checkout issues.
    
*   Review cloud costs and developer/code changes.

Try it!

Get a 7-day free trial and see what it catches in your first 24 hours https://dailyhelm.com/Any feedback or feature requests are welcome.  
  
Thanks so much!

comments.text:
@bdennis11907 Many congratulations on the launch, Brandon! :)

How I met the maker?

I met the maker through a PH friend of mine. The moment I saw the product and Brandon’s past experience, I knew I had to support the product launch. We worked together on the product messaging and making it launch ready.

What does the product do?

DailyHelm is an AI business reviewer for founders and growth teams. It monitors analytics, ads, SEO, and store data overnight, then turns scattered signals into a prioritized daily action list... complete with evidence, confidence, recommended fixes, and likely revenue impact.

Why I endorse it?

I endorse DailyHelm because it solves a real, expensive problem: founders often have plenty of dashboards but not enough clarity on what to fix first.

Instead of asking teams to interpret charts, it surfaces revenue leaks, such as broken tracking, wasted ad spend, SEO regressions, or checkout issues, and tells them what deserves attention today.

I am a growth consultant to many startups. While the growth teams focus too much on the marketing tactics, they miss learning from analytics and fixing critical issues on time.

Brandon has built this with a clear operator-first mindset: actionable recommendations over vanity metrics, prioritization by impact, and specialist agents that make the daily review feel genuinely useful rather than noisy.

If you run a DTC brand, SaaS, agency, or a lean online business, this is worth trying, especially if you want to start each morning knowing exactly where to focus. :)

제품의 기능:

DailyHelm은 창업자와 그로스 팀을 위한 AI 비즈니스 리뷰어입니다. 밤사이에 분석, 광고, SEO, 스토어 데이터를 모니터링한 뒤 분산된 신호들을 근거, 신뢰도, 권장 조치, 예상 매출 영향도가 완비된 우선순위 일일 실행 목록으로 변환합니다.

DailyHelm이 실질적이고 값비싼 문제를 해결하기 때문에 추천합니다. 창업자들에게는 수많은 대시보드가 있지만 정작 무엇을 먼저 고쳐야 할지에 대한 명확성이 부족한 경우가 많습니다.

Brandon은 허영 지표보다 실행 가능한 권장 사항, 영향도에 따른 우선순위 지정, 노이즈가 아닌 진정으로 유용한 일일 리뷰를 만드는 전문 에이전트 등 명확한 실무자 우선 마인드로 이 제품을 구축했습니다.

DTC 브랜드, SaaS, 에이전시, 또는 린(lean) 온라인 비즈니스를 운영하고 계시다면, 특히 매일 아침 어디에 집중해야 할지 정확히 알고 시작하고 싶다면 꼭 사용해 볼 가치가 있습니다. :)
